summary: The owner adopted the Challenge training budget study as a standing launch requirement: every Challenge completes it, with its own sheet, before its training limit is set and before it pays rewards. Launch path v1.0.8 records it. Readiness records move to schema carbon.challenge-readiness.v2 with a required training_budget_study block, and the validator refuses a launch approval until the study is COMPLETE with a result and an owner decision; every record starts NOT_STARTED. Decision rules R1-R8 are frozen by SHA-256, checked by a test. Miners see the published curves and rule. Battery runs first once its sheet is supplied; no pod time is spent before then. The study is off-chain development evidence and grants no scientific, security or production qualification.
